verdict.rationale: ImageMagick ships C/C++ and language-binding APIs and a CLI, so a versioned-API and deprecation-policy question applies to it. The pack only mentions migration guidelines for porting commands and a version-gated feature (7.1.1-16 security policies). Neither is a documented API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy, so they are adjacent material and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
